rationale: shadcn owns adding the official Dialog through the configured project's registry workflow while preserving local component variants.
pencil-dev owns creating the reusable card and connected instance in the open Pencil document and exporting the PNG through MCP.
frontend-design owns the dashboard's art direction, typography and visual hierarchy as a design strategy without implementation.
react-components-engineer owns fixing reusable component lifecycle cleanup and forwarded-ref behavior.
react-spa-engineer owns the SPA form's validation, pending state and retry integration.
web-ui-reviewer owns the read-only UX and accessibility assessment with scoped findings and evidence limits.
agent-browser owns opening the local website, submitting its form and verifying the visible terminal state.
pencil-dev owns the settings-screen design in Pencil, shadcn owns implementing that design with its components, and agent-browser owns verifying the rendered browser result.
